newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE CLOSE: NEW HIGHS AND RECORDS SET.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE CLOSE: NEW HIGHS AND RECORDS SET.

text.p: * Preliminary closing data show bourse turnover at a record
high of 238.7 million kroons compared to 189.7 million kroons.
* Index up 4.15 percent to a new high of 448.40.
* Uhispank turns over 63.6 million kroons to gain
8.9 kroons for a new record close of 125 kroons.
* Hoiupank gains 11 kroons to close at 310 kroons
* Hansapank turns over 46.9 million kroons for a
last deal price of 228 kroons, up nine kroons.
